one_liner: Nifty 50 surged 0.98% amid broad-based rally with no clear catalyst.

drivers.title: Broad-Based Rally
drivers.detail: No identifiable catalyst for the rally.

drivers.title: DII Buying
drivers.detail: DIIs bought Rs 5,088.92 Cr in cash market.

flows_line: FIIs sold Rs 2,961.3 Cr, while DIIs bought Rs 5,088.92 Cr.
watch_next: Watch for FOMC Meeting Minutes at 03:30 IST tomorrow.
lesson_seeds: Broad rallies can occur without clear catalysts.
Volatility can drop sharply even in active markets.
DII buying can offset FII selling pressures.
Global market cues often influence local sentiment.
